messages:
jamie: Quick sync — need to align HW vendor roadmaps with marketplace onboards and SI phasing. Focus: H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Primary asks: embargo windows, marketplace lead time, SI cert duration. @maria @arjun can you share latest dates?

maria: Nvidia deck shows H100 availability around 2025-09-15 (rough). H200 is TBD but they mentioned Q4 ramp. MI300 still on track for Q3 2025 in their last note.

arjun: Gaudi partner told me their GA target is early 2026 but dev kits land ~Nov 2025. They want a staged marketplace approach (dev preview -> SI cert -> public listing).

jamie: OK — two constraints from our side: marketplace listing needs ~4w lead (marketing + legal), SI certing usually needs 6w for our integration checklist, and press embargo windows want 2w of notice. So realistic earliest public announce = vendor GA + 6w cert + 4w marketplace.

elena: For B200 we should prioritize Dedicated burst pools if supply exists — ops flagged limited SKUs for B200 in early shipments. That affects customer-facing messaging.

sophie: Product needs a joint announcement template and a one-pager for partners. Also confirm whether partners will allow co-marketing quotes inside embargo.

jamie: Proposed handoff playbook (very rough):
```
1) Vendor signals GA (tentative date)
2) Redwood requests embargo window (±2w) and co-marketing ok/no
3) Dev preview (if available) -> internal SI cert (4w)
4) SI public cert & marketplace listing prep (4w)
5) Go/no-go 48h before embargo lift
```

arjun: Suggest we create a phased SKU mapping: Dev (no SLA), Beta (limited SLA, marketplace hidden), GA (public). Keeps customers clear.

maria: I'll ask Nvidia contacts for precise H100/H200 B200 shipment windows and whether they can commit to a 2w embargo handshake. Also ask for MI300 confirmation.

elena: Ops — can we reserve a small B200 pool for SI testing if vendor confirms dev kits? @deploy-bot can you create a ticket for capacity hold?

deploy-bot: Created ticket #INF-3287: hold 4x B200 units in staging for SI testing (owner: ops). ETA: pending vendor ship dates.

sophie: I'll draft the announcement template and share in ~24h. Also adding a checklist for legal approvals.

jamie: Next steps: maria to push vendor dates by EOD Wed, arjun to draft phased SKU mapping, sophie to draft template, elena to log capacity hold. We'll reconvene after vendor replies. :thumbsup:

maria: Ack — pinging vendor contacts now.

arjun: Will drop a PR with SKU mapping by Tuesday.

jamie: Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates. If anything changes about embargo flexibility, call it out immediately.
